work.note: Tidying Up with Marie Kondo é uma série do Netflix, lançada em 2019, com a especialista japonesa em organização Marie Kondo. facts.big: Can you help me…? · Where is…?
facts.label: Anexar um arquivo
facts.sub: Peça Can you help me attach this file? Pergunte Where is the file? Confira Should I paste the link? e peça Can you look at my draft?

facts.label: Anexos
facts.sub: Um anexo é um arquivo enviado junto com o e-mail. Procure o botão Attach, escolha o arquivo e espere carregar. Confira se o anexo aparece antes de apertar Send.

facts.label: Drive compartilhado
facts.sub: Muitas equipes guardam arquivos na nuvem, em um drive compartilhado. Você faz o upload do arquivo, e os colegas fazem o download quando precisam dele.

Coworkers often help each other with computers. → Verdadeiro (It is normal to ask.)

pages.title: Drag it into the email · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday afternoon in an open office in Atlanta. Tom has five tabs open on his computer screen. He needs to send a report to his boss by three o’clock. The report is in the download folder, but he cannot find it. His coworker Priya sits at the next desk. She sees his face and rolls her chair over.
“Hi, Tom! Do you need a hand with the report?” says Priya. “Yes. Can you help me attach this file?” says Tom. “Sure. Put the cursor on the draft, then click Attach.” says Priya.
